title: have the merge of main into a slice branch check that every item marked as having a slice still has its slice file, so a missing scaffold is caught before a land round and needs no model repair

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (deterministic-check) on slicer in ork run ork-20261118-151517-1d8b, project ork, item S439:

have the merge of main into a slice branch check that every item marked as having a slice still has its slice file, so a missing scaffold is caught before a land round and needs no model repair

Evidence: S448 and then S450 each needed a land-round repair after a merge of main, both because of "marked as having a slice, but no file exists"
